gloss: putting into writing; documenting; converting into written form

definitions.gloss: putting into writing; documenting; converting into written form
definitions.explanation: The act of expressing ideas, rules, or information in written form.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{内容|ないよう}を{文章化|ぶんしょうか}する。
examples.english: To put the meeting's contents into writing.

examples.japanese: {口頭|こうとう}での{約束|やくそく}を{文章化|ぶんしょうか}しておいた{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: It's better to put verbal agreements into writing.

examples.japanese: {暗黙|あんもく}のルールを{文章化|ぶんしょうか}して{全員|ぜんいん}に{共有|きょうゆう}した。
examples.english: We documented the unwritten rules and shared them with everyone.

notes:
Combines {文章|ぶんしょう} (writing/text) and {化|か} (transformation/conversion). The {化|か} suffix is highly productive and creates verbs meaning "to convert to" or "to make into." {文章化|ぶんしょうか} is commonly used in business and organizational contexts when formalizing rules, procedures, or agreements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文章化|ぶんしょうか}する: to put into writing, to document
- ルールを{文章化|ぶんしょうか}する: to document rules
- {文章化|ぶんしょうか}された{規則|きそく}: documented rules

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {文書化|ぶんしょか}: documentation — very close synonym, slightly more formal/bureaucratic
- {書面化|しょめんか}: putting into written form — emphasizes the official document
- {言語化|げんごか}: verbalization — putting thoughts into words (spoken or written)
